clips.title: The story
paras: In Bloodhoof Village, Mull Thunderhorn watches over Mulgore’s sacred wells. He serves the Earth Mother and guards the balance of the land. Outside exploitation threatens the waters, and he guides young tauren in cleansing the ancestral springs.

Mull Thunderhorn watches over Mulgore’s spiritual well-being from Bloodhoof Village. The nomadic tribes have gathered under High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof to make a permanent home, but greed and reckless expansion already threaten their lands. Mull guides young braves setting out from Camp Narache and calls on them to protect their ancestors’ vital resources.
